description:
#TIMEFLIK Subscriber Exclusive Watch Face

This watch face is provided exclusively for subscribers.
You can check the watch face applying history on My Page > Recently Sent.
When your subscription expires, you can no longer access a watch face.

#Features

[Time & Date]
 - Analogue Time
 - 12/24 Hour Format
 - Date

[Device]
 - Watch Battery

[Weather]
 - Current Weather

[Etc.]
 - Alway on Display

#Notice

 - Weather and health information can be set in the TIMEFLIK mobile & watch app.
 - Be sure to allow access to the location and sensor in the watch app to display the weather and health information.

descriptionI18n.ko:
#타임플릭 구독 전용 워치페이스

구독 전용 워치페이스는 정기 구독자만 사용할 수 있는 전용 상품이에요.
보내기 한 워치페이스는 마이페이지 최근 적용 목록에서 확인하실 수 있어요.
구독이 만료되면 워치페이스를 더 이상 적용할 수 없음에 유의해 주세요.

#주요기능

[시간 & 날짜]
 - 아날로그 시계
 - 12/24시간 포맷 지원
 - 날짜

[디바이스 정보]
 - 배터리 잔량

[날씨 정보]
 - 날씨

[기타]
 - Alway on Display

#주의사항

 - 날씨 및 헬스 정보는 타임플릭 모바일 앱과 워치 앱에서 설정할 수 있어요.
 - 날씨 및 헬스 정보가 표시되지 않으면 워치 앱에서 위치 정보와 센서의 접근 권한이 허용되어 있는지 확인해 주세요.

descriptionI18n.ja:
#タイムフリックサブスク専用文字盤

サブスク専用文字盤はサブスク決済後に使用できる専用商品です。ダウンロードした文字盤はマイページの最近適用でご確認できます。サブスクが期限切れになると文字盤の使用はできなくなりますので、注意してください。

#ご案内

 - 天気およびヘルス情報はタイムフリックアプリとウォッチアプリで設定できます。
 - 天気やヘルス情報が表示されない場合は、ウォッチアプリで位置情報と
センサーのアクセス権限が許可されていることを確認してください。

commentList.content:
Justice has finally been served in the "I want state-of-the-art Ultra-OLED, (7.4K-Liter Cummins mega-quad-turbo diesel-digital smartwatch/Camper-RV combo!) department! This beautiful thermonuclear timemachine, capable of disguising itself as an antiquated-analog standard chronograph timepiece with so many darn sub-dials, you can't even pretend to be able to decifer what-in-the-hell time it is anyway...anywhere...ever! (please excuse me entertaining my punchy-ass self...0 sleep in 48 hours and I was laughing at myself over my relentless quest to find the most perfect...amazing analog watch face...for my smartwatch...I cannot do a modern digital futuristic style of faces! What's worse is I have about 12 really nice mechanical watches from Bulova-Invicta-Seiko-and couple others that are super nice! But I loose days of my life scouring the innerwebs in search of the perfect digital-analog chronograph watch face....for my digital smartwatch... For Shame! My initial point was going to be me Thanking you profusely for creating "my perfect analog digital watch face!" That I couldn't see in my own head what would have made happy...or that'd I'd blow my brains out from frustration with creating it!
Anyways sorry for the rant! You absolutely have made the most amazing and perfect watch face I've seen in 2 years plus! Name's Taylor! thank you again
